title: Anti-look-ahead historical decision frame boundary

clockModel.decisionAt: ISO timestamp supplied by replay job
clockModel.cutoffBlock: authoritative highest block strictly before decisionAt

embargoes.futureOrders: excluded unless placement and last update are at or before cutoff block and before decision second
embargoes.futureFills: excluded unless block is at or before cutoff block and timestamp is before decision second
embargoes.openingPrice: included only with an explicit availableAtBlock at or before cutoff

tests.targeted: PASS - pnpm --filter @edgelab/replay typecheck && pnpm vitest run tests/unit/replay.test.ts
tests.adversarialFutureMutation: PASS - mutating future candles/orders/fills and market outcome fields leaves frame hash identical
tests.strictBoundary: PASS - data at the decision second is excluded
tests.runtimeSchema: PASS - extra winningOutcome, closingPriceRaw, and resolution fields are rejected

limitations: REPLAY-001 defines the pure frame boundary only; REPLAY-002 will connect it to resumable replay jobs.
The caller must supply the authoritative cutoffBlock from the block lookup layer.
